question: Which of the following missions was announced by NASA for the study of the deep of the planet Mars?
solution:
The correct answer is __**InSight Mission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mars rover mission **by **NASA's Mars exploration program is **planned to **launch in 2020**.
 
• The **Mars 2020 InSight Mission **mission is **part of NASA's Mars Exploration Program**.
 
• It was a **long-term effort **of robotic exploration of the **Red Planet**.
 
• The **Mars 2020 mission **launched on **July 30, 2020.**
 
• It's **motive is **to **search for signs **of **ancient microbial life**.
 
• Mars rover **mission by NASA's Mars **exploration program will also **gather rocks and Soil**.
 
• It will **include **a **testing method **for **producing oxygen **from the **Martian atmosphere**.
 
• The **Mars 2020 **spacecraft uses a **guided entry, descent, and landing system**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NASA**:

 
 
• The full form of NASA is the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
 
• It is an independent agency of the US federal government.
 
• It is responsible for the civil space program, aeronautics research, and space research.
